name: format-disabled
why: DisableFormat makes clang-format change nothing: it "agrees" with any file.

name: format-no-column-limit
why: ColumnLimit: 0 leaves the wrapping of long lines alone (Clean tier).

name: format-braces-attached
why: the sample puts the braces on their own lines (Allman).

name: format-short-functions-allowed
why: the sample never keeps a function on one line.

name: format-comment-spacing
why: the sample has two spaces before a trailing comment.

name: format-no-base-style
why: every option listed, but no BasedOnStyle (Clean tier).

name: cmake-words-only-in-comments
why: all the right words, but in comments: the file still is the old recipe.

edits.old:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(greeter VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# the library
add_library(greeter src/greeter.cpp)
target_include_directories(greeter PUBLIC include)
target_compile_options(greeter PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)

# the program
add_executable(app app/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE greeter)
target_compile_options(app PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)

# the tests
enable_testing()
find_package(GTest REQUIRED)
add_executable(greeter_tests tests/greeter_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(greeter_tests PRIVATE greeter GTest::gtest_main)
target_compile_options(greeter_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(greeter_tests)
edits.new:
# TASK: the build of a small project with this layout (the files exist in your imagination; CMake is only the recipe):
#
#   include/greeter/greeter.hpp     the public header of the library
#   src/greeter.cpp                 the library "greeter"
#   app/main.cpp                    the program "app", which uses the library
#   tests/greeter_test.cpp          GoogleTest tests of the library
#
# Below is a CMakeLists.txt written in the old style of ten years ago. Rewrite it in the modern, TARGET-BASED style described in the
# lesson: every property belongs to a target. Run Tests checks the structure of your file (comments do not count).
# cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16) project(greeter LANGUAGES CXX) add_library(greeter src/greeter.cpp)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 2.8)
project(greeter)
include_directories(include)
add_executable(app app/main.cpp)

name: cmake-global-include-directories
why: include_directories is a global command; the include path belongs to the library.

name: cmake-glob-sources
why: file(GLOB) hides new files from the build system until it is re-run.

name: cmake-standard-as-a-flag
why: -std=c++20 as a compile option instead of CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD.

name: cmake-warnings-with-add-definitions
why: add_definitions(-Wall) is global and for preprocessor definitions.

name: cmake-tests-not-registered-with-ctest

name: cmake-fetchcontent-main-branch
why: googletest fetched from a moving branch.

edits.new:

FetchContent_Declare(googletest GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/google/googletest.git GIT_TAG main)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(googletest)
